findings.title: Invalidate connected calendars after deleting the cache
findings.body: The delete-cache success handler only invokes the optional onSuccess callback; it never invalidates the connectedCalendars query that supplies cacheUpdatedAt. SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper passes its optional onChanged prop through without refetching that query and disables refetchOnWindowFocus. When no refetching callback is supplied, a successful deletion therefore leaves the old cache timestamp and Delete cached data action visible. Invalidate connectedCalendars on successful deletion, as the disconnect mutation already does.

findings.title: Use a portable in-place edit for the webhook environment variable
findings.body: The `sed -i '' -E` invocation uses BSD/macOS syntax and fails with GNU sed on Linux. When GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL already exists, the script does not update it but still prints the success message, leaving Google webhook testing pointed at the previous tunnel. Use a portable replacement approach and check that the edit succeeds before reporting success.
